tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. White in Explore and print, black in Live. Never a dark gray (#1a1a1a–#333333) on black: projectors render it as black.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, rings, the axis, hairline rules and focus outlines on `ground`. 21:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `ground`: helper text, captions, corner metadata. 5.3:1 on white; 10:1 on black in Live (extra margin for video compression).

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Non-text only: unfilled rings in the progress mark, inactive touchpoints, placeholder borders. 3.0:1 on white, 3.1:1 on black — never use for text.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Print and the white die-cut border of every cutout. Fixed in both themes.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Raw black. Inverted panels in Explore (a black block on a white page).

tokens.name: muted-on-black
tokens.usage: Secondary text on a `black` panel inside Explore only. 7.5:1. In Live use `muted` instead (#b3b3b3).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid outline, 2px offset. Same as `ink`: there is no accent color, focus included.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Build a world, not just a product
styles.usage: Section headlines and the title. Fluid: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.5rem). Sentence case.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: Everything you make has an orbit.
styles.usage: The one-line reading that opens every section. Fluid: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem). Also the belief label on the axis.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The product sits inside the experience. The experience sits inside the world.
styles.usage: Running text. Max 64 characters per line (`measure`).

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Corner metadata, ring names, buttons. Always UPPERCASE (text-transform: uppercase).

styles.name: field
styles.usage: Workshop inputs. 16px exactly — smaller triggers iOS zoom on focus.

styles.name: live-display
styles.sample: The screen is the smallest part of it.
styles.usage: Live headline. Fluid: clamp(2.75rem, 6vw, 5.5rem). Weight 400, never 300: projectors swallow light weights.

styles.name: live-body
styles.sample: Name one thing in each ring.
styles.usage: Live body text. 28px is the floor. 30 body words per view, maximum.

styles.name: live-label
styles.usage: Ring names, touchpoint labels and controls in Live. 18px is the floor (readable from the back row). UPPERCASE.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a touchpoint and its label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to field; tight inline gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Mobile side gutter; padding inside buttons and placeholders.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between stacked fields; between reading and headline.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Corner inset: every corner element sits at least this far from the edge. Live safe area top and bottom.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Live safe area left and right — Zoom banners and captions eat the edges.

tokens.name: space-section
tokens.usage: Vertical space between sections in Explore.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Max width of the Explore text column, centered.

tokens.name: breakout
tokens.usage: Max width a diagram may break out to in Explore.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Every rectangle: buttons, fields, placeholders, panels, images. Square corners everywhere.

tokens.name: radius-ring
tokens.usage: Rings and touchpoints only. Rings are the only curves on the site.

stroke.note: Line weights for rings, axis and rules. Live values are the floor for screen-share legibility.

tokens.name: stroke-ring
tokens.usage: Rings in Explore diagrams.

tokens.name: stroke-mark
tokens.usage: Rings in the 40px Explore progress mark.

tokens.name: stroke-axis
tokens.usage: The point-of-view axis in Explore.

tokens.name: stroke-rule
tokens.usage: Hairline rules, field underlines, placeholder borders. Explore and print only.

tokens.name: stroke-ring-live
tokens.usage: Rings in Live diagrams.

tokens.name: stroke-mark-live
tokens.usage: Rings in the 64px Live progress mark.

tokens.name: stroke-axis-live
tokens.usage: The axis in Live.

tokens.name: stroke-rule-live
tokens.usage: Rules and borders in Live; hairlines vanish over video.

tokens.name: stroke-ring-print
tokens.usage: Rings in print. World ring dotted at 0.75pt.

dash.note: stroke-dasharray values. Rings are told apart by line style plus a label, never by style alone.

tokens.name: dash-world
tokens.usage: World ring in Explore diagrams: dots, with stroke-linecap round.

tokens.name: dash-world-mark
tokens.usage: World ring in the 40px mark — dots disappear at that size.

tokens.name: dash-world-live
tokens.usage: World ring in Live diagrams; dots blur into a gray line on video.

tokens.name: dash-world-mark-live
tokens.usage: World ring in the 64px Live mark.

tokens.name: dash-unfilled
tokens.usage: An unfilled ring in the progress mark, stroked in `faint`.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Progress mark, top right, Explore.

tokens.name: mark-live
tokens.usage: Progress mark, top right, Live.

tokens.name: mark-mobile
tokens.usage: Ring header above the stacked workshop fields on mobile.

tokens.name: touchpoint
tokens.usage: Touchpoint (planet) diameter in Explore.

tokens.name: touchpoint-live
tokens.usage: Touchpoint diameter in Live.

tokens.name: axis-overshoot
tokens.usage: How far the axis runs past the World ring, each side.

timing.note: Durations. No transition runs longer than 1s; reduced motion shows the final state instantly.

tokens.name: t-ring-draw
tokens.usage: A ring draws in (stroke-dashoffset, ease-out): scope expanding.

tokens.name: t-ring-draw-live
tokens.usage: Ring draw in Live, so it doesn't stutter at low frame rates.

tokens.name: t-line
tokens.usage: Text enters line by line.

tokens.name: t-stagger
tokens.usage: Stagger between lines.

tokens.name: t-axis
tokens.usage: The axis aligns or breaks.

tokens.name: t-touchpoint
tokens.usage: Touchpoints settle onto their rings.

tokens.name: t-mark-turn
tokens.usage: One rotation of the Explore mark. Optional; never in Live.
